products.name: Attack Surface Management (ASM)
products.description: Continuous discovery and inventory of APIs, applications, and cloud assets using subdomain enumeration, AI-powered fingerprinting, and OSINT techniques.

products.name: Business-Logic-Aware DAST
products.description: Agentless dynamic application security testing (no proxy/agent) with 140+ automated attack scenarios targeting OWASP API Top 10, BOLA/IDOR, access-control and business-logic flaws, plus native GraphQL testing (introspection, type-aware payloads, resolver testing).

products.name: AI Pentesting
products.description: Agentic, continuous penetration testing (launched ~July 2025) using a multi-agent architecture: a coordinator/orchestrator agent manages pentest state and delegates to specialized agents for assessment, reporting, and context handling within sandboxed tools.

features.name: GraphQL-native security testing
features.description: Introspection-based schema analysis, type-aware payload generation, resolver testing.
features.how_it_works: Uses feedback-driven API exploration rather than brute-force scanning to reach deeper application states.

features.name: Multi-user / role-based authorization testing
features.description: Automatically tests authorization boundaries between different user roles to catch Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) and Broken Authentication.
features.how_it_works: Simulates multiple authenticated sessions/roles against the same endpoints to detect permission boundary violations.

features.name: Incremental / CI-integrated scanning
features.description: Scans only changed endpoints in pull requests, integrates with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, CircleCI.
features.how_it_works: Public API and CLI trigger scans from CI pipelines; v3 API released August 2025.

features.name: Complex auth-flow support
features.description: Handles OAuth 2.0, AWS Cognito, JWT, MFA-protected applications.
features.how_it_works: unverified in detail beyond vendor/review claims

features.name: graphql-armor (open source)
features.description: Security middleware adding a protective layer to Apollo GraphQL Server / Yoga / Envelop servers.
features.how_it_works: npm middleware package; reported 100,000+ weekly downloads.

pricing: Not publicly listed. AWS Marketplace shows an Enterprise Plan with 3 capacity tiers (up to 15, 60, or 120 scanned applications), unlimited scan frequency, dedicated support; AWS Marketplace Private Offers available for negotiated pricing. A free tier for scanning a single API was also reported by a third-party review (AppSecSanta). Exact dollar figures: unverified.
